content.what_it_is: `boundary_condition_module` provides GPU physical-boundary flux correction and ghost-cell exchange. Two CUDA kernels zero/mirror fluxes around masked cells; `BOUNDARY_CONDITION_FLUXES_GPU` sets west/east/south/north edge fluxes with coupling, wavemaker, periodic and MGPU gates and launches those kernels (L1-L329). `EXCHANGE_DISPERSION_GPU` fills or periodically exchanges the many dispersive derivative halos with parity appropriate to each derivative (about L340-L785). `EXCHANGE_GPU` exchanges primary eta, mask, velocity, transport, breaking-age/viscosity and flux arrays then masks velocities/transports (L800-L866). `PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH_GPU`, real `PHI_COLL_GPU`, `periodic_NSexchange_gpu`, and integer `PHI_COLL_INT_GPU` implement reflection, periodic north/south exchange and MGPU halo exchange for scalar/vector parity types (L875-L1852).
entities: module boundary_condition_module at L1; cudafor/PARAM/GLOBAL/mod_cuda imports at L2-L35; generic PHI_COLL_GPU interface for real and integer implementations at L38-L41
boundary_condition_X_kernel and boundary_condition_Y_kernel CUDA routines in approximately L57-L151 with VALUE bounds, optional neighbor ranks, Gamma3 and local I/J
BOUNDARY_CONDITION_FLUXES_GPU in approximately L153-L329 with local I/J
EXCHANGE_DISPERSION_GPU in approximately L340-L785 with local VTYPE and I/J/K
EXCHANGE_GPU in L800-L866 with local VTYPE and I/J
PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH_GPU in approximately L875-L951 with INTENT(IN) dimensions/bounds/VTYPE, device INTENT(INOUT) PHI and local I/J/K
real PHI_COLL_GPU in approximately L963-L1588 with conditional PERIODIC argument, device real PHI, local I/J/K and MGPU host buffers/status
periodic_NSexchange_gpu in approximately L1592-L1656 with device real PHI and MGPU buffers
integer PHI_COLL_INT_GPU in approximately L1662-L1852 with conditional PERIODIC argument, device integer PHI, local I/J/K and MGPU integer buffers/status

equations.ref: east coupled boundary flux in the post-coupling segment, continued at L214
west odd reflection of xx derivative
west odd reflection of depth-weighted xx derivative

calls: boundary_condition_X_kernel and boundary_condition_Y_kernel launches around L304-L324 followed by cudaDeviceSynchronize
periodic_NSexchange_gpu for dispersion arrays in the CARTESIAN periodic block around L344-L388
PHI_COLL_GPU for Eta, AGE_BREAKING, nu_break, MASK, U/HU and V/HV in L809-L847; generic resolution selects integer PHI_COLL_INT_GPU for MASK_d
PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH_GPU for staggered P_d and Q_d around L821-L822
MPI_SENDRECV and cudaMemcpy2D in real periodic exchange around L1001-L1043 and L1609-L1652, and integer periodic exchange around L1690-L1750
phi_exch_cuda at the end of real and integer PHI collectors (around L1585 and L1848)

unresolved: COUPLING east-boundary copy/paste/name defect: the first excluded east segment uses imported Gamma3, but the second segment uses `Gamma3_d` at L213. `Gamma3_d` is absent from the restricted GLOBAL and mod_cuda import lists at L7-L35 and is not locally declared under IMPLICIT NONE, so a COUPLING build reaches an undefined identifier; the otherwise identical formulas use Gamma3.

Non-MGPU interface mismatch: `boundary_condition_Y_kernel` conditionally omits n_suth/n_nrth from its non-MGPU argument list, but `integer,value :: n_suth,n_nrth` remains unconditional at L116. VALUE applies to dummy arguments, so those names are declared with VALUE while not being dummies in that configuration. The host non-MGPU launch likewise omits them, confirming the signature/declaration mismatch.

The GPU exchange explicitly states that the CPU EXCHANGE preprocessing FILTERING block is absent at L859-L860. Whether GPU and CPU runs are expected to be numerically equivalent when that switch is enabled cannot be resolved from this file.

Real and integer MGPU periodic paths repeatedly call `cudaMemcpy2D` with pitches and widths expressed as Mloc or Mloc-2*Nghost (for example L1001-L1011 and the analogous integer block). The file does not state whether the CUDA Fortran overload interprets these quantities as elements or bytes; if it follows the byte-count API, REAL(SP)/INTEGER rows are under-copied by their element size. The interface definition is outside this file and must be checked.

The real PY==1 periodic copies omit an explicit cudaMemcpy kind while the analogous integer copies include cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice. Whether overload inference makes the two paths equivalent is not documented here.

Boundary kernels iterate through expanded Ibeg-1:Iend+1/Jbeg-1:Jend+1 ranges and write neighboring indices such as I+1 or J+1. Safety assumes at least the corresponding ghost width and consistent Iend/Jend placement; the kernels receive no Mloc/Nloc and perform no outer allocation-bound check.

VTYPE 4 y-boundary handling is explicitly described as not an exact solution and simply zeros cross-derivative ghosts (around L1320-L1417); the approximation's effect and intended conditions are not specified.

The generic interface declares module procedures with the same generic/specific spelling `PHI_COLL_GPU` plus `PHI_COLL_INT_GPU` at L38-L41. Compiler acceptance of a generic sharing the real specific's name is compiler-language-version dependent and is not established here.
